title: Rescue Twin
line: A light twin in rescue red under white, with a hoist and a five-blade rotor.

title: Light Utility
line: A compact five-blade utility helicopter in white with a teal belly band.

title: Firefighter
line: The utility airframe in gloss fire red over white, with a belly water tank.

title: Utility Transport
line: A medium utility helicopter in flat dark green, with door guns.

title: Maritime Patrol
line: The naval variant in light ghost grey, with a radome and a torpedo.

title: Heavy Lift
line: A tandem-rotor heavy lifter in olive drab, its rotors turning in opposite directions.

title: Light Scout
line: The light observation airframe in matte black, armed with rocket pods and miniguns.

title: Tandem Gunship
line: A tandem-seat attack helicopter with a chin gun, sensor turret and stub wings.

title: Tandem Gunship II
line: The newer, darker gunship with a mast-mounted radome above the rotor.

title: Twin Attack
line: A narrow twin-engine attack helicopter in gunship grey with a four-blade rotor.

title: Escort Attack
line: A compact escort helicopter in two-tone green-grey camouflage with a roof sight.

title: Assault Gunship
line: A heavy assault gunship in desert camouflage over a pale belly, with a chin gun.
